entities.name: Heinrich Bullinger
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Swiss reformer (1504–1575) who succeeded Zwingli as head of the Zurich church, authored the Second Helvetic Confession, and shaped Reformed Protestantism through prolific correspondence across Europe.
